title: Ensorain evidence adapter + native assay + preregistration + freeze
objective: The smallest adapter that runs the chosen Ensorain world through the Observatory evidence path, with native controls and a preregistered endpoint, frozen.
problem: Per COMPATIBILITY.md. Reuse registry components within their scope (`python -m rso.registry.registry for-adapter`); record every component reused, modified, or found too narrow (source-specific assumptions in common components are a deliverable). Count bespoke adapter lines. Native controls per directive s4; discovery / evaluation seeds separated and disjoint from every WTP-05 registered seed; a preregistered endpoint and decision rule; a resource spec (s13: consumption, parallelism, stopping, reproducibility, checkpoint need). Freeze manifest (LF-normalised sha256) before any subject outcome. NO confirmatory run.
non_goals: No edit to ensorain/ or roles/Ensorain/ (frozen WTP-05 code, seeds, runs)
No edit in another seat's lane
evidence_required: known-answer positive detected and forbidden channel refused on development seeds
ONBOARDING.md rows: adapter lines, components reused / modified, semantic mismatches

acceptance.condition: all evidence_required items; committed with source references
